status: Immutable measured plan for root adoption and independent judge review; not asset approval
scope: Nine discrete representative physical stances on an exterior route. No continuous stair locomotion, door traversal, character edit or runtime mechanic is asserted. Source geometry, native action pose, authored scale1.25, materials, camera and original Floor04 art unchanged.

supportLaw.formula: rootZ = max(0, groundZ - shoeTriangleZ, upwardSupportTriangleZ - shoeTriangleZ) over every finite XY triangle-overlap polygon vertex for both complete visible shoe meshes
supportLaw.surfaceSet: Actual upward-facing Floor04 surfaces including bevels/seams/nails plus Entry06 continuous loadbearing tread solid; post/cap/peg meshes excluded as support and included as collision obstacles. Ground plane Z0 outside/under assets.
supportLaw.finiteContact: Full overlap polygons with solved plane residual within 1e-5, with area/centroid/bounds/hull and flat-sole/projected-shoe fractions. No highest-vertex or min-sole-only contact certificate.
supportLaw.fullTriangleNonpenetration: Linear plane difference extrema evaluated at every exact convex overlap polygon vertex; full shoe triangles, not isolated probes.
supportLaw.placedRootRule: Each source-facing S root Z computed once and frozen. Entire floor/entry/actor/companions assembly rotates S0/E+pi2/Npi/W-pi2 about world origin with same XY/Z and source frame. No per-facing solve or nudge.

nativeCohorts.entry: static exact Entry06 at S root[0,-1.5,0]

actor.meaning: Actual unchanged action samples; mixed representative snapshots, not a generated staircase animation.

originalCompanions.evaluation: Exact visible native evaluated mesh/material copies frozen in memory at companion frame12 before actor independently samples frame7 or12. Every snapshot world vertex exactly matches source evaluation. No source blend/action saved or edited.

approvedHutAdditionalFixture.relationship: Separately labeled additional native fixture; current primary consumer uses exact currently published original hut. Future rebuilt submarine clearance not inferred.

projection.meaning: Published real35degree actor atlas is primary consumer reference. Native55degree complete-body context is a separate technical physical reference; no cross-projection pixel parity claim.
